name: Ducati 900SS / 750SS
engine: 748-992 cc air-cooled 90-degree L-twin, two-valve desmo, carbs (to 1997) or fuel injected
intro: Ducati's air-cooled Supersport. A trellis frame, a two-valve desmo twin and carbs on the early ones.

add.title: Check the timing belts and desmo valve clearances
add.instructions: Replace the cam timing belts on schedule, by age as well as miles, and check the desmo opening and closing clearances. Old belts can snap and wreck the engine.
add.reason: Ducati belt-drive twins need belts changed on time even if the bike sat.

G: 1991-1997 bikes have carbs. 1998-on bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
